alerts.headline: Bajaj Finance shares jump over 2% as NBFC launches Rs 11,700-crore QIP; floor price set at Rs 992.25
alerts.summary: Bajaj Finance shares jumped over 2% after the NBFC launched a Rs 11,700-crore QIP at an indicative price of Rs 1,025 per share, part of its broader Rs 17,500-crore fundraising plan.
second_order_candidates: Winner: Bajaj Finance - the QIP books drew demand strong enough that the stock trades above the floor, which signals institutional appetite for the new equity and adds lending headroom (same event as [bb39a831f2e4]). The price move (+4.3% to 1110.8 per the Yahoo quote, alert [5f36dd9706ba]) is folded in here.
Losers: none clear; the stock now sits roughly 12% above the Rs 992.25 floor, so a late chaser takes the risk that QIP allottees book profit. Dilution is covered under [58a4e14d9d53].
Catalyst: scheduled - allotment and listing of QIP shares follow within days; next dated event is the 4 Dec 2026 RBI decision.

Thesis fit: open thesis bajaj-finance-rbi-december: neutral to slightly weakens - the stock has run toward a 52-week high before the queued entry (decision_date 2026-11-19), so the entry price is likely higher. No draft: the QIP is public and priced in.
